thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 2244681234 - Multi-region failover health: increased 5xx in eu-west-2 and us-west-2. Traffic shift to us-east-1 initiated automatically but drains are stuck. Affected routes: /api/v1/generate. Pager: P1.

alex: ACK. I'm on it. Pinged on-call and paging infra. gathering context.

leila: I'm taking primary triage. Seeing spike in 502/504 from edge in eu-west-2. Traffic shift was kicked ~2244681200 by autoscale policy due to AZ drain.

sanjay: Network note: BGP session flapped earlier in us-west-2 at ~2244681000, routes might have been reannounced. checking route cache now.

emily: Support: customers reporting timeouts in EU and APAC. Initial customer impact list created. statuspage waiting for update.

maria: Can we pause the cross-region traffic-shift? If drains are stuck, shifting more traffic could make it worse.

alex: Initiating pause. Command:
```
/infra traffic-shift pause --id shift-2026-03-15-5
```
Response: OK paused. shift status = draining_pending.

leila: Logs from healthcheck:
```
time=2244681215 svc=generate instance=i-0a1bc2 status=502 backend_error="read timeout"
```
KV cache shows many prefix misses.

sanjay: routecache show:
```
eu-west-2 -> local 10.2.3.0/24 (healthy)
us-east-1 -> remote 10.5.6.0/24 (draining)
us-west-2 -> remote 10.7.8.0/24 (unhealthy)
```
I see inconsistent origin AS on prefixes for us-west-2.

jack: Product: major customers in EU seeing degraded latency and failed requests. Need to keep this P1 and update customers ASAP.

emily: I've opened ticket INC-2026-047 with SEs for top 5 accounts. Posting recommended text for status page: "We are investigating a cross-region failover that is causing elevated error rates for generation API. Engineers are actively mitigating."

alex: Eng oncall -> @tanya you up for handoff in 20? I need to loop legal/comms.

tanya: I can take next 2hr rotation. handoff ok.

leila: Quick mitigation plan:
- Pause the shift (done)
- Abort any partial route reannouncements in control plane
- Force full drain on problematic instances with a 10s healthcheck backoff
- If drain doesn't finish in 10m, rollback to global active-active with rate-limit to protect backend.

sanjay: Contacting cloud provider now: support ref 789321. They confirm an internal LB config async apply in us-west-2 that left half of instances in "initializing" state.

maria: Can we temporarily set upstream healthcheck to 30s and increase retry to reduce 5xx flapping? Risk: longer recovery for actual failures.

alex: Execute runbook snippet for manual drain:
```
for id in $(infra list-instances --region us-west-2 --service generate --state draining_pending); do infra drain-instance --id $id --force --timeout 600; done
```
Running.

incident-bot: :pager: On-call escalation to leila at 2244681300 (acknowledged).

leila: Drain progress: 3/8 instances failed to move from "draining_pending" after force. Getting "connection reset" on backend.

sanjay: Networking got confirmation of BGP flap causing some traffic to be blackholed for ~3m earlier. They applied a session reset; asking us to re-run route announce.

alex: I'm going to re-issue announce for us-west-2 prefixes once drains finish. Meanwhile rolling back shift to balanced: run:
```
/infra traffic-shift set-mode --id shift-2026-03-15-5 --mode balanced
```

emily: Status page update suggestion: "Mitigation in progress — traffic shifts paused, targeted instance drains underway, cloud provider engaged. Some customers may see intermittent errors."

jack: Customer comms: preparing an email for top 10 customers with ETA 2 hours. Need severity confirmation.

leila: Metrics: error rate for /api/v1/generate peaked at 18% in eu-west-2 and 12% in us-west-2. Latency steady but tail increased.

maria: I'm going to spin a small warm standby in eu-west-1 to absorb leftover traffic. Launching warm pool (t=2).

incident-bot: cloud-provider-bot: Support ticket updated 789321 -> cloud provider: internal LB stuck in initializing state; they are terminating and recreating the LB.

sanjay: After forcing reannounce and provider fix, route tables look consistent. Still seeing healthcheck timeouts from app side; possible net filter on instances.

leila: App logs show a GC spike correlating with errors. Stack:
```
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded
service=generate instance=i-0a1bc2
```
maria: Rolling config that adjusts JVM heap limits and reduces max threads on the instance group. Pushing config to canary group first.

alex: Handoff to @tanya now — summary: paused shift, forcing drains, cloud recreating LB, some instances OOMing; spun warm pool in eu-west-1; please continue drains and decide rollback if drains don't complete in 10m. Everything in runbook channel.

tanya: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate with infra and follow rollback if necessary. Updating status page and pinging comms.

emily: I've posted a public incident note: "Investigating - generation API experiencing errors due to regional failover issues. Engineers working on mitigation." :white_check_mark: 

leila: Drain complete on 5/8, 3 still flapping. We have 2 options now:
1) Force terminate the 3 flapping instances and replace (fast, may cause connection churn)
2) Rollback shift to active-active with rate limits (safer)

sanjay: Cloud suggests option 1; they will terminate and recreate with correct LB config.

alex: +1 for terminate-and-replace. Lowers surface area quicker.

tanya: I'll execute termination on those 3 now. Command:
```
infra terminate-instance --id i-0a1bc2,i-0d4ef5,i-0f6gh7 --region us-west-2 --replace
```
Running.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: System: termination succeeded, replacements healthy after 120s.

leila: New instances report healthy, 200 OK for healthchecks. Drains cleared. Reannouncing routes.

sanjay: Route propagation looked good. Global route table now consistent.

maria: Warm pool in eu-west-1 taking 12% traffic, error rate down to 3% EU.

jack: Customers: top 10 contacted, 3 replies asking for more detail. Comms team prepping follow-up.

emily: Updating incident severity to Sev2 given partial recovery, but monitoring for full green.

alex: Closing notes for handoff to postmortem: suspected root causes = cloud LB async config + BGP session flaps + app OOM amplifying failures during drain. Actions set: improve runbook for pause+drain, add pre-shift health gating, add JVM heap telemetry alarm, add route announce verification step.

tanya: I'll keep watch for 30m and then update incident channel. Thanks team. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident 2244681234 status = mitigated at 2244681560, postmortem assignment created PM-324.

End.
